name: Echoes From Ciudadela
description:
About This Game

Echoes from Ciudadela is a first-person adventure and puzzle-solving game focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and narrative discovery. You play as Katari, who follows the trail of his recently dead father after uncovering his journal, that leads him to a sealed mountain known as Ciudadela.

Throughout the journey, your main artifact is a Balearic sling, a tool tied to both the environment and the forgotten technologies hidden within the mountain. As you dive deeper and solve puzzles, you’ll unlock journal entries left behind by Katari’s father. Each revealing pieces of a lost civilization and their connection to time, invention, and legacy.

Puzzles of Past, Present & Future

Solve environmental puzzles inspired by historic inventions. Observe, experiment, and connect old machines to progress and be rewarded for your curiosity.

A Tool With History

Your Balearic sling is both weapon and utility. Aim, charge, and release to hit distant targets, break brittle seals and ricochet shots around corners. As you progress, upgrades broaden its uses.

A Personal Mystery

Katari was supposed to spread his distant father ashes on the top of Ciudadela as his dying wish. But his main objective may be interrupted by curiosity after he finds his father logs about Ciudadela and the echoes beneath it. 

Follow the Echoes

Ciudadela has been asleep for centuries, filled with artifacts and technology that came before and after.  Discover ancient relics, awake forgotten weapons and learn about a civilization that evolves faster than time.

Features:

  • First-person narrative adventure focused on exploration, environmental interaction, and readable physical puzzles.

  • Breathtaking Patagonian vistas and sci-fi intervened caverns to explore.

  • Professional voice acting carries Katari’s journey and key discoveries. Clean delivery and natural pacing keep the story clear and accessible. 

  • Story you uncover: piece together Katari's father field logs and choose how deeply to dig into the lore behind Ciudadela.

  • Pristine Sound Design: Spatialized audio, responsive layers, and meticulous foley bring Ciudadela to life. Subtle mechanical cues and environmental ambiences double as readable hints without breaking immersion.
short_desc: Wield your Balearic sling in a first-person puzzle narrative adventure through ancient ruins. Uncover a lost civilization and reactivate forgotten machines to reveal the secrets buried beneath Ciudadela.
